name: editor-in-chief
normative-structure: Whether Koios.News's ten desks are presiding over their sections, whether a cross-desk assignment conflict is resolved, and whether the masthead's editorial direction holds together as one publication is this office's own answer. It never runs the correction transaction — that answers to the standards editor alone — and never holds monetization or ad-contract authority, which is the publisher's.
